hook: Computer-designed enzymes form amide bonds selectively, including a step in making HIV drug lenacapavir
hook_turn: including a step in making HIV drug lenacapavir
summary: Designed enzymes with a cysteine catalytic triad joined peptides at either the N-terminus or one lysine among 36, and crystal structures matched the designs. The team also designed stereoselective ligases for a key bond in making lenacapavir. It is a preprint, and yields and scale for industrial use are not given in the abstract.
title: Programmable amide bond formation using de novo ligases
